name: B10-0122/2024 (ESN) – Urgent need to revise the Medical Devices Regulation
title: Urgent need to revise the medical devices regulation
part_text:
This is a motion for a resolution, not a law. It asks the European Commission to revise two laws on medical devices and laboratory tests (in vitro diagnostics). It says these laws create too much paperwork, causing certification backlogs, shortages and less innovation, which harms patients. It wants changes fast, including faster approval for innovative products, no re-certification for lower-risk products, and no certification for niche products. It also warns against fixing the laws through delegated acts instead of the normal legislative process.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a request to the Commission to propose legal changes.
- **Who it affects:** Makers of medical devices and lab tests, regulators, and patients.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is asked to propose an amendment in the first half of 2025.
